capabilities: create annotate blocks from the editor context menu and edit them in place
style selected text groups with colors, underlines and alignment
add ruby-style phonetic marks above or below text
save reusable group styles as one-click preset buttons
preview generated render or HTML output with change highlights
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; manual installation from releases is required. The plugin works entirely offline, makes no network requests, and stores annotations as HTML inside notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to annotate text with per-group colors, configurable underlines or phonetic annotations stored in the note itself.
summary: Annotation plugin that adds styled text groups, colored underlines and ruby-style phonetic marks inside annotate blocks in notes.
